items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 22:1
items.html: The essence of Arich Anpin is two heads: the Galgalta and the Sealed Brain. The Galgalta illuminates in the head alone, and these are thirteen corrections, as in Answer 20 above — namely the Galgalta, the two ears, the forehead, the two eyes, etc. And the Sealed Brain illuminates outside the head, in the thirteen corrections of the beard and the body; see there. And the Galgalta itself is divided into two heads, according to the division of the Tzelem: the Galgalta is the aspect of MEM, in concealed Hassadim, in which the Yud does not go out of the air; and the LAMED is Mocha deAvira, which is the aspect of revealed Hassadim, in which the Yud goes out of the air and light remains, as is known. Hence the head is divided into these two aspects: the place of the hairs is the aspect of the Galgalta, in which the Yud does not go out of the air, and therefore the hairs are fixed there; and the revealed place is the aspect of Mocha deAvira — namely from the forehead and below, where there is a part without hairs, that is, over the whole surface of the face.
